translation:
Guifu talc (桂府滑石) (six liang), licorice (甘草) (one liang, used raw).

Grind the above into a fine powder; take three qian each time. For those with great thirst who wish to drink cold [water], using freshly drawn water is especially excellent.

Zhudu Wan (豬肚丸) treats wasting-thirst and wasting-midst (消中).
translator_notes: 桂府滑石 rendered as 'Guifu talc' (place-name qualifier).
